text: ふえのねを　きいた　ポケモンは　めを　さました！

structure.jp: ふえのねを　きいた　ポケモンは
structure.en: the Pokémon that heard the sound of the flute

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: ふえのねを　きいた　ポケモン
patterns.explanation: A phrase ending in a verb, placed right before a thing, describes that thing. ふえのねを　きいた　ポケモン = 'the Pokémon that heard the sound of the flute'.
